methods.holders: Transfer-log replay to the block at the bucket edge (Robinhood RPC); contracts (pools, routers, launchpads by bytecode) excluded
methods.earlyRetentionPct: first 20 wallets receiving tokens from a contract still holding
methods.buyers: wallets receiving tokens from a contract (pool / router)
methods.sellers: wallets sending tokens to a contract
methods.devBuySharePct: deployer (sender of the first mint tx) share of tokens bought from contracts
methods.devSoldPct: deployer tokens sent to contracts / tokens received
methods.priceUsd: GeckoTerminal main-pool candle close (5m to +24h, then 1h)
methods.volume24hUsd: sum of GeckoTerminal candle USD volume over the trailing 24h (main pool)
methods.drawdownPct: last close vs highest close so far
